about_the_game:
Main features

  • Fast-paced top-down action gameplay

  • Twin-stick shooter

  • Local co-op up to 4 players

  • Character and weapon upgrades

  • More than 100 different enemies

  • 20 levels in 4 different worlds

Cyber Siege - Kepler-186 Under Attack!

It's the year 2347, and the four planets in the Kepler-186 system face a huge danger: the Voidborn. This hostile alien alliance wants to drain the planets' life force. The only hope against them are two advanced defense robots, called mechs. These mechs have the same basic programming, but players can change them with different parts. Their computer brains work perfectly together, always knowing what the other will do.

The invasion happens on different kinds of worlds:

World 1: Veridia - Gray Planet: The Voidborn first appear in Veridia's underground. They take over a huge maze of tunnels filled with a strange, pale blue light. The mechs go into these Azure Labyrinths to clear out the Voidborn and protect important equipment. They fight enemy constructs and learn how to defeat their ethereal enemies in the tight, glowing tunnels.

World 2: Crystalia - Orange Planet: The fight on Crystalia gets much scarier. Deep inside its crystal caves live giant, glowing spiders – some real, some advanced robots. The Voidborn's power makes these spiders even more dangerous. In these Arachnid Depths, the mechs must move through dark tunnels and around sharp crystals, fighting swarms of these mutated spiders. They use light and sound weapons to confuse and destroy them in the dark.

World 3: Xylos - Blue Planet: The third world, Xylos, is a strange planet with a blue sky and glowing plants. The Voidborn set up bases across its wide, alien lands – the Indigo Expanse. The mechs must get used to the weird gravity and alien life. They fight Voidborn units that blend into the environment, using long-range weapons and smart moves to defeat them in the huge, blue wilderness.

World 4: Technos - Red Planet: The final battle takes place on Technos, inside the Voidborn's main base – the Core Nexus. This place is a strong, high-tech area with lots of machines, energy pipes, and powerful defenses, all now controlled by the Voidborn. The mechs must use all their upgrades and teamwork to break through the defenses and face the Voidborn leader. This is the last, desperate fight for the Kepler-186 system in this ultimate tech challenge.

Throughout their mission, players strategically customize mech loadouts to best suit the challenges of each unique world. The key to survival lies in understanding the environments, exploiting enemy weaknesses, and harnessing the synchronized power of these two adaptable mechs.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 64-bit 
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz Intel or AMD
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2GB AMD R9 285 (GCN 3rd Generation), 2GB Nvidia GTX 680 
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 64-bit 
  • Processor: Zen 2 4c/8t, 2.4-3.5GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8GB AMD Radeon RX 480, 8GB Nvidia GTX 1080 
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Cyber Siege is a fast-paced twin-stick shooter with pure gameplay. Play solo or in local co-op up to 4 players. Upgrade your character and weapons as you fight 100+ enemy types across 20 levels in 4 distinct worlds.
